svg.title: Drawing 01 — Existing and proposed ground-floor plans — Kelvinside Garden Room
svg.desc: Existing plan with a fragmented rear kitchen, scullery and WC projection beside a proposed plan in which the rear rooms are reordered into a kitchen and utility and a new garden room extends across the full width of the house.
